data: The largest moon of Uranus and eighth-largest in the solar system. Voyager 2 imagery revealed a surface cut by enormous canyon systems — Messina Chasma alone stretches 1,500 km across the southern hemisphere — alongside large impact basins and the small fresh-looking Ursula crater. A 2017 stellar occultation tentatively detected a thin carbon-dioxide atmosphere, which would be the first atmosphere found on a Uranian moon.
Water-ice + silicate rock; ancient cratered terrain cut by vast canyon systems hundreds of kilometres long — Messina Chasma stretches ~1,500 km across the moon.
Titania is the largest moon of Uranus (1,578 km diameter) — comparable in size to Pluto. Only Voyager 2 has imaged it (1986).
Galileo's four-night observation in 1610 ended geocentrism. The system's moons are still ending old assumptions today.
